# Extract titles from archive list
archive_titles = {}
for entry in songs_to_archive:
    # Format is "Title by Artist"
    parts = entry.rsplit(' by ', 1)
    title = parts[0]
    artist = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
    archive_titles[title] = artist

# Find matching songs in playlists
songs_to_remove = {}  # playlist_id -> list of song_ids
all_matched_song_ids = set()

for pid, songs in playlist_songs.items():
    for s in songs:
        if s['title'] in archive_titles:
            # Need to verify artist - let me get song details
            song_details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=s['id'])
            artists = ', '.join([a['name'] for a in song_details.get('artists', [])])
            expected_artist = archive_titles[s['title']]
            if artists == expected_artist:
                if pid not in songs_to_remove:
                    songs_to_remove[pid] = []
                songs_to_remove[pid].append(s['id'])
                all_matched_song_ids.add(s['id'])
                print(f"Match: Playlist {pid}, Song {s['id']} - {s['title']} by {artists}")

print(f"\nTotal unique songs to remove: {len(all_matched_song_ids)}")
print(f"Playlists affected: {list(songs_to_remove.keys())}")
